kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
حققت (form I)
# حَقَقْتُ (ḥaqaqtu) /ħa.qaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# حَقَقْتَ (ḥaqaqta) /ħa.qaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# حَقَقْتِ (ḥaqaqti) /ħa.qaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# حُقِقْتُ (ḥuqiqtu) /ħu.qiq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
# حُقِ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
